summary: Inspected the retained page-owned responsive screenshots and measurements at 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 390 and 375 px. Fonts are ready at every width. Overflow is zero from 1440 through 390 px, while 375 px reports 1 px. The archive filters disappear entirely at 768 px and below without a visible mobile trigger, and the 1024 px layout retains a 345 px sidebar beside a 619 px three-column grid, visibly compressing card controls.
issues: PA-RESP-001 [P1] filter availability: expected filtering to remain accessible at narrower widths; actual archive-filters measures 0x0 at 768, 390 and 375 px and no page-owned mobile filter trigger is visible. Fix: provide a responsive native filter panel or trigger.

PA-RESP-002 [P1] grid/control layout at 1024 px: expected readable unbroken card controls; actual layout keeps the 345 px sidebar beside a 619 px grid split into three columns, causing add-to-cart labels to wrap and card internals to be excessively compressed. Fix: reduce columns or change the filter/grid breakpoint before this width.
PA-RESP-003 [P2] horizontal overflow: expected 0 px overflow; actual retained 375 px measurement reports 1 px. Fix: identify the viewport-edge element and confirm zero horizontal overflow.
